E0506

`Set<T>` element type is not hashable (D-COLLBREADTH1)

What

`Set<T>` element type is not hashable (D-COLLBREADTH1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0506

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0506: tests/ui/set_unhashable.stderr.

Error [E0506]: `Set<Float>` is not valid — `Float` is not hashable
  --> tests/ui/set_unhashable.jet:3:14
    |
  3 |     s :: Set.from([1.0, 2.0])
    |              ^^^^
 Why: Set elements must implement Hash and Eq; use Int, Bool, String, Char, or a named type
 Fix: change the element type to a hashable type, or use a `[Float]` list instead
